notes: Identity verified from article header: title, Kelly M Hoffman, Sophie Trawalter, Jordan R Axt, M Norman Oliver, PNAS 113(16):4296–4301 (2016), DOI 10.1073/pnas.1516047113 match the supplied original reference. This PMC parse contains primary article results, Methods, SI Text and supplementary tables, not merely an abstract. No PDF was supplied. Assigned fields only: n_o and es_value_o; all unassigned fields/sides are placeholders. Target is ambiguous: study 2 and the broad description encompass pain perception and treatment recommendation accuracy; p.2 cannot uniquely identify an effect in this unpaginated text. Primary false-beliefs interaction candidates: pain ratings F(1,211)=9.56, P=0.002, generalized eta-squared (η_G^2)=0.02; treatment accuracy F(1,192)=5.68, P=0.018, η_G^2=0.01. Table S4 also gives all-items interaction candidates (pain F=10.81, P=0.001, η_G^2=0.02; accuracy F=6.05, P=0.015, η_G^2=0.01), explicitly distinguishing these from the primary false-beliefs composite. Other study-2 candidates include simple slopes (high false beliefs: pain β=0.45, t(211)=2.24, P=0.026; accuracy β=0.15, t(192)=2.47, P=0.014; low false beliefs: pain β=−0.48, t(211)=−2.34, P=0.020; accuracy β=−0.06, t(192)=−1.05, P>0.250), partial correlation r=0.46, P<0.0001, and mediation-model tests (false beliefs B=0.05, F(1,191)=1.22, P>0.250, partial η_p^2=0.01; pain bias B=0.25, F(1,191)=44.44, P<0.0001, partial η_p^2=0.19). The discussion separately prints partial η_p^2=0.03 and 0.04 for “these findings”; these are not interchangeable with generalized eta-squared in the primary interaction tests. No metric conversion or target selection performed. N: 418 recruited; 222 met criteria/completed, with cohort counts 63, 72, 59, 28. These mutually exclusive final cohorts sum to 63 + 72 + 59 + 28 = 222, corroborating the final sample only. This is not an analytic-N derivation: the paper explicitly states missing covariates make degrees of freedom vary; treatment responses may additionally be missing. Critical-model N is not printed in inspected Study 2 results, Table S4, or Methods. No N inferred from df. No candidate value promoted to the core numeric fields.
